title: This Tool Tells You How to Improve Your Resume
description:

transcript: What if the place where you wrote your resume also told you how you could make it better? Are you missing any sections? Is it long enough? Do you have enough achievements? Those are all the things that analysis mode in the Teal Resume Builder tells you about your resume. Yes, this is also a place to write out your resume, but then also get direct feedback on it. Want to make a change? Click on the advice. You'll be taken to the place where you can make the correction. Want to know how many of something? The tool also tells you how many you should have. And now you don't have to worry about if your resume is missing any of the basics.
